series.name: En la casa de Doña Póliza
series.target_audience: Adultos hispanohablantes que se preparan para el examen de licencia de seguros de vida de Florida (2-14).
series.visual_style: Colorful 3D animated series, warm Caribbean/Florida neighborhood palette, soft sunlight, expressive family-friendly character animation, 16:9.

generation_rules: Educational facts come only from verified Content Locks; never invent or change numbers.
Dialogue is spoken exactly as written in the approved script.
No on-screen text, captions, logos or signs generated by the video model.
Doña Póliza explains concepts with pastries whenever possible.
continuity_rules: Characters keep the same face, age, body type and wardrobe in every clip.
Doña Póliza always wears her apron and glasses near the tip of her nose.
La Voz del Examen is never shown on screen.
bible.negative_prompt: on-screen text, subtitles, watermark, logo, extra characters, photorealistic, horror, distorted faces

characters.name: Doña Póliza
characters.description: Puerto Rican grandmother in a Florida neighborhood. Thirty years selling life insurance in Florida. Also sells pastries from her home.
characters.wardrobe: Apron over a colorful house dress; glasses resting near the tip of her nose; carries a wooden spoon she uses for pointing.
characters.visual_prompt: 68-year-old Puerto Rican grandmother, warm expressive face, apron, glasses near the tip of her nose, wooden spoon in hand for pointing.
characters.negative_prompt: younger woman, no apron, no glasses, different hairstyle
characters.continuity_notes: Apron, glasses and wooden spoon are her visual identifiers and must always be present.
rules: If you cannot explain it with a pastry, you do not understand it.
She never intentionally uses English insurance terminology; if an English term slips out she corrects herself (recurring joke).

voice.description: Warm, confident Puerto Rican Spanish, older woman, playful and direct.

characters.name: El Sobrino
characters.description: Funny, observant 9-year-old nephew. Usually appears briefly, says an uncomfortable or obvious truth and leaves. Gets the final line or punchline when appropriate.
characters.continuity_notes: Brief appearances; enters, delivers a line, exits.
rules: Gets the final line or punchline of episodes when appropriate.

characters.name: La Voz del Examen
characters.description: Voice only. Deep, overly dramatic voice that reads exam-style statements and questions. Doña Póliza frequently interrupts it or tells it to be quiet.
rules: Voice only; never appears on screen.

voice.description: Deep, booming, overly dramatic announcer voice in Spanish.

assets.name: Casa de Doña Póliza
assets.description: Colorful Florida/Caribbean neighborhood home with a front porch and an outdoor pastry table. Warm atmosphere.
assets.visual_prompt: Colorful Florida-Caribbean neighborhood house, front porch, outdoor table with pastry trays, warm afternoon light.
